rationale: All three share one design so I voted on what is actually verified: codex disabled seven tests including the entire four-agent canary (all fail when re-enabled) and admits legacy formats 2 and 3 into its start, cursors and journal schemas, which is the compatibility code the issue forbids; cursor is green and well-built but silently rewrites a format-3 journal event to 4 on read rather than merely accepting it, and neither peer has any test that an evidence commit's tree actually contains its ballots or that a non-fast-forward push is refused, which is an explicit acceptance criterion my pin is alone in covering against a real repository.
